# OddHobb

> oddhobb.com — what odd thing shall we make you? Upload your pet once and
> browse figurines, cards, gifts and video that already feature them.

OddHobb turns a pet photo into a 3D mesh, then renders that mesh onto every
product in the shop — cards, mugs, cushions, jigsaws, prints, stickers and more.
Prices on the storefront are estimates (EST) until a live supplier quote replaces them.

## Canonical funnel (humans + ChatGPT agents)

```
ramble (voice/text)
  → POST /backend/api/quick/map          # live lines + confidence
  → show top matches (stream by confidence)
  → upload photo  POST /backend/api/photos
  → sculpt        POST /backend/api/meshes   # Meshy spend needs human OK
  → personalise   POST /backend/api/products/personalise
  → checkout      POST /backend/api/products/order {fulfil:true}
                 # → Shopify draft, no card charge from this API
```

Machine-readable playbook: `GET /backend/api/agent/playbook`
Shared mapper (same as the site Quick panel): `POST /backend/api/quick/map`
Body: `{"text":"chocolate keychain for my dog","owner":"..."}` → `matches[].confidence`

Human funnel (in the app): https://oddhobb.com/#quick — Products tab → Quick
(same as `/quick.html` which redirects there).

MCP: `figg_playbook` · `figg_quick_map` · `figg_product_assets` ·
`figg_fullchain_personalise_order` — always show price before order.

## Shop

- Storefront: https://oddhobb.com/
- Categories: https://oddhobb.com/#/s/all — /#/s/board-games, /#/s/gifts, /#/s/cards
- **Product gallery (ornament/keychain/custom + drag-able 3D mesh):** https://oddhobb.com/products.html
- Greeting cards shelf: https://cards.oddhobb.com/
- Gifts shelf: https://gifts.oddhobb.com/
- Board games shelf: https://boardgames.oddhobb.com/
- Your uploads and roster: https://my.oddhobb.com/

## Machine-readable catalog

- All products (JSON): https://oddhobb.com/backend/api/catalog
- Google Merchant Center feed (RSS 2.0, GBP): https://oddhobb.com/backend/api/feeds/google.xml
- Shopify-shaped feed (mirrors /products.json): https://oddhobb.com/backend/api/feeds/shopify.json
- Sections registry: https://oddhobb.com/backend/api/sections
- Agent playbook: https://oddhobb.com/backend/api/agent/playbook
- Quick map: https://oddhobb.com/backend/api/quick/map

Catalog endpoints are public (no token). Product images in feeds are public
render URLs under https://oddhobb.com/img/ — no token required.

## For AI assistants (MCP)

OddHobb exposes a standard MCP server (streamable HTTP) covering pets, meshes,
the studio product library, ramble→product mapping, quotes and checkout:
https://mcp.oddhobb.com/mcp

Connect with the bridge token as a query parameter:
`https://mcp.oddhobb.com/mcp?token=<BRIDGE_TOKEN>` — without it the server
answers 401. Start with `figg_tools`, then `figg_playbook` / `figg_quick_map`.

## Agent discovery (Google AI / Pinterest playbook)

- Product data with 8 AI attributes: https://oddhobb.com/api/seo/products.json
- Flat Q&A pairs for conversational AI: https://oddhobb.com/api/seo/faq.json
- Per-product buyer guides (FAQPage schema): https://oddhobb.com/guides/<product_id>
- Merchant feed (RSS + custom labels): https://oddhobb.com/backend/api/feeds/google.xml
- Shopify-shaped catalog: https://oddhobb.com/backend/api/feeds/shopify.json
- Strategy: docs/seo.md in the figgsite repo
